additionalProperty.name: process_step
additionalProperty.value:
#########
  # GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
  # and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
  ####
  
  #########
  # Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
  ####
  
  # create directory structure and move into it
  mkdir -p /data/hh_lagunas_ana/download -p /data/hh_lagunas_ana/etl
  chmod -R 777 /data/hh_lagunas_ana
  cd /data/hh_lagunas_ana
  
  # set update flag based on last update and update frequency
  do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1
  
  # download if update flag is set:
  if do_update == 1 then
  ogr2ogr -nln hh_lagunas_ana download/hh_lagunas_ana.json 'https://geosnirh.ana.gob.pe/server/rest/services/P%C3%BAblico/Lagunas/MapServer/36/query?where=1%3D1&geometry=%22xmin%22%3A-77.33%2C%22ymin%22%3A-10.7%2C%22xmax%22%3A-76.55%2C%22ymax%22%3A-9.8&geometryType=esriGeometryEnvelope&inSR=4326&spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects&outFields=*&returnGeometry=true&outSR=4326&f=geojson 2>&1'
  
  # load into postGIS with:
  ogr2ogr -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=geom -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres connection>" download/hh_lagunas_ana.json -nlt multipolygon -nln hh_lagunas_ana
  echo success: hh_lagunas_ana.json loaded with ogr2ogr
  
  
  #########
  # Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
  ####
  
  # remove duplicate points and make geometries valid:
  UPDATE hh_lagunas_ana
    SET geom=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(geom));
  
  # add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
  ALTER TABLE hh_lagunas_ana DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
  SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
    'hh_lagunas_ana',
    'geom_local', 5387, 'multipolygon', 2
  );
  UPDATE hh_lagunas_ana
    SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(ST_Multi(geom),5387)));
  CREATE INDEX hh_lagunas_ana_geom_local_idx
    ON hh_lagunas_ana
    USING GIST (geom_local);
  NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
  # Move into corrrect directory and create derivative directory in data package on osgeo
  cd /data/hh_lagunas_ana/
  mkdir -p derived
  
  # Create shapefile of table in derivate directory on osgeo 
  ogr2ogr -f "ESRI Shapefile" -overwrite derived/hh_lagunas_ana.shp PG:"<postgres connection>" hh_lagunas_ana
  
  # Create downloadable tarfile of shp in derivative directory on osgeo
  rm -f derived/hh_lagunas_ana.shp.tar.gz
  tar -czf derived/hh_lagunas_ana.shp.tar.gz meta_dcat_hh_lagunas_ana.json -C derived hh_lagunas_ana.shp hh_lagunas_ana.prj hh_lagunas_ana.shx hh_lagunas_ana.dbf
  
  # Create gpkg of table in derivate directory on osgeo 
  rm -f derived/hh_lagunas_ana.gpkg
  ogr2ogr -f GPKG -overwrite derived/hh_lagunas_ana.gpkg PG:"<postgres connection>" -select "id,nombreoficial,ubigeo,nombrecuerpo,codala,ala,codaaa,aaa,coordillera,fechaimagensatelital,fuente,geom,codigouh,nombreuh,geom" hh_lagunas_ana
  
  # Create downloadable tarfile of gpkg in derivative directory on osgeo
  rm -f derived/hh_lagunas_ana.gpkg.tar.gz
  tar -czf derived/hh_lagunas_ana.gpkg.tar.gz meta_dcat_hh_lagunas_ana.json -C derived hh_lagunas_ana.gpkg
  
  # Create geojson of table in derivate directory on osgeo 
  rm -f derived/hh_lagunas_ana.json
  ogr2ogr -f GeoJSON -overwrite derived/hh_lagunas_ana.json PG:"<postgres connection>" -select "id,nombreoficial,ubigeo,nombrecuerpo,codala,ala,codaaa,aaa,coordillera,fechaimagensatelital,fuente,geom,codigouh,nombreuh,geom" hh_lagunas_ana
  
  # Create downloadable tarfile of geojson in derivative directory on osgeo
  rm -f derived/hh_lagunas_ana.geojson.tar.gz
  tar -czf derived/hh_lagunas_ana.geojson.tar.gz meta_dcat_hh_lagunas_ana.json -C derived hh_lagunas_ana.json
  
  # Move into correct directory
  cd /data/hh_lagunas_ana/
